label: Occam’s razor and infinite regress: preference beyond every finite factor requires zero rival weight
paraphrase: Fix a finite hypothesis with positive real weight and an infinite regress hypothesis with nonnegative real weight. The finite weight is at least every positive finite real multiple of the infinite weight exactly when the infinite hypothesis weight is zero.

connection_plan.missing_bridge: An application premise for one actual causal relation: equal explanatory adequacy of a finite-ancestry account and an infinite-regress account of the same recipients, together with a defended prior assignment in one model that gives the whole regress class zero weight (for example uniformly discounted depth events containing every admitted regress alternative, or independent commitments each covering finitely many positions); and a rule by which such a probabilistic preference supports the deductive premise e529c42f.
connection_plan.blocker: No prior assignment is defended for an actual regress: a single charge for a shared generating law permits positive weight at every depth (SharedLawCharge), equal likelihoods leave the prior odds unchanged (EqualLikelihoodOdds), and the corpus has no argument form from a probabilistic preference to a deductive premise (docs/notes/causal-finitism-367.md, Occam section).
